accounts_medal_ranking_idx.name: accounts_medal_ranking_idx
accounts_medal_ranking_idx.where: "scoresaber-accounts"."medals" > 0 AND "scoresaber-accounts"."banned" = false AND "scoresaber-accounts"."country" IS NOT NULL AND "scoresaber-accounts"."country" <> ''

accounts_medal_ranking_country_idx.name: accounts_medal_ranking_country_idx
accounts_medal_ranking_country_idx.where: "scoresaber-accounts"."medals" > 0 AND "scoresaber-accounts"."banned" = false AND "scoresaber-accounts"."country" IS NOT NULL AND "scoresaber-accounts"."country" <> ''

accounts_clear_medals_rank_idx.name: accounts_clear_medals_rank_idx
accounts_clear_medals_rank_idx.where: ("scoresaber-accounts"."medalsRank" <> 0 OR "scoresaber-accounts"."medalsCountryRank" <> 0) AND NOT ("scoresaber-accounts"."medals" > 0 AND "scoresaber-accounts"."country" IS NOT NULL AND "scoresaber-accounts"."country" <> '' AND "scoresaber-accounts"."banned" = false)

accounts_active_country_idx.name: accounts_active_country_idx
